name: GVMS — create a Goods Movement Record

comment: HMRC accepts a GMR submission without returning the record: the outcome arrives
later through the Push Pull Notifications API. That asynchrony is the whole
reason the Customs Worker exists, so the stub reproduces it faithfully rather
than shortcutting to a 201 with a body.
The X-Stub-Gmr-Id header is not part of the real API — it is here so a local
test can correlate the submission with the notification stub without guessing.
